Parameters (in) MirroringActive TRUE: Mirror_ReportCanFrame will be called for each frame received or transmitted on the given controller. FALSE: Mirror_ ReportCanFrame will not be called for the given controller. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: Mirroring mode was changed. E_NOT_OK: Wrong ControllerId, or mirroring globally disabled (see CanIfBusMirroringSupport). Description Enables or disables mirroring for a CAN controller. Available via CanIf.h
